## Summary
- Refresh pipeline preset selectors immediately when presets are saved or loaded
- Preserve in-progress pipeline field edits while updating preset options
- Add a Cypress regression for saving a preset after the Pipeline tab is already open

Fixes Jhon-Crow/audio-recorder-with-visualization#143

## Tests
- `npm run typecheck`
- `npm test -- --runInBand`
- `npm run build`
- `CYPRESS_baseUrl=http://localhost:8080 npx cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/pipeline-mode.cy.js`

## Screenshots
Not applicable: selector refresh behavior is covered by Cypress.
